root: version-controlled minimal bootstrap delivered as part of the initial HTTPS document from one pinned secure origin; it pins the manifest URL and exact SHA-256 outside the manifest
authority_chain: deployment owner controls origin, TLS termination, root HTML, bootstrap bytes, and response headers
root bootstrap supplies the manifest URL and exact expected SHA-256; the manifest never authenticates itself
the authenticated manifest binds one immutable runtime profile while the supervisor creates a fresh external runtime-generation token
manifest digests authenticate every fetched runtime and release artifact
generation supervisor grants only the fixed deny-by-default POC import surface and rejects every optional host capability
preflight: WebAssembly and required thread features are available
navigator.serviceWorker.controller is null and controllerchange cancellation is armed before acquisition
selected policy and schema versions are supported

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; worker-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

header_scope: the root document and every Worker response must carry compatible COEP/CORP, MIME, no-sniff, cache, and CSP policy; every executable, manifest, and release response is same-origin and CORP-compatible
manifest_policy: fetch with credentials omit, redirect error, cache no-store, and identity content encoding; enforce the one-MiB representation ceiling while reading, hash the exact bytes against the bootstrap-pinned SHA-256 before parsing, then reject invalid UTF-8, duplicate object names, excessive nesting/records, unknown fields, and cross-field bound violations
redirect_policy: manual/error at every fetch; any redirect fails preflight
cache_policy: no-store request and response for the first proof; no fallback to a cached generation
service_worker_policy: no registration in proof scope; an active controller fails preflight; registration races and controller changes cancel the generation
worker_integrity: fetch each single-file Worker bundle with credentials omit, redirect error, cache no-store, and identity content encoding; bound and verify its manifest SHA-256, construct an executable Blob URL only after verification, register URL and Worker before effect, prohibit importScripts, dynamic/static imports, child Workers, and other descendant executable fetches, and revoke URLs during cleanup
wasm_policy: fetch bounded bytes, verify the complete manifest SHA-256, then call WebAssembly.compile/instantiate; streaming compilation is disabled for the first proof
negative_cases: invalid UTF-8 or duplicate manifest member
generated loader claims to authenticate its own root
tradeoffs: the secure origin and root bootstrap remain trusted and can replace both code and policy
pinning an exact manifest digest is intentionally simple but requires a root-bootstrap update for every accepted profile revision
blob execution is admitted only for supervisor-created verified bytes and expands CSP review
disabling streaming and HTTP content encoding increases transient bytes and startup or transfer cost
no-store prevents offline reuse and must be revisited with a signed cache/update design
stop_conditions: deployment cannot provide the required secure context and isolation headers recursively
CSP cannot support the reviewed verified-byte Worker mechanism
a Worker bundle requires unverified descendant imports
